        "Fresh full two-file261-line mbox refactor read. The internal stream helper loses its nsIMsgDBHdr parameter and no longer opens the database; the public GetNewMsgOutputStream wrapper still retrieves/optionally creates the header and writes its store token immediately after stream creation. Thus database-free final API and finish-time token return are the stated migration goal, not fully implemented by this first patch. Header absence still warns and continues under the referenced legacy reliance rather than creating a new fail-fast guarantee.",
        "The helper captures the mbox file offset, builds the buffered/mbox-aware stream with an optional quarantine wrapper, and records StreamDetails{filePos,stream} by folder URI. This prepares future finish-time token delivery. Complete Bug and four actual review rows read: suggestions to return the token immediately or remove the then-unused offset are rebutted by planned later parts; reviewer accepts with that follow-up context. The many later landing descriptions in the Bug are context, not credited source audits.",
        "Fixed source exposes the database-free getNewMsgOutputStream/finishNewMessage/discardNewMessage interface. Finish calls the safe stream Finish before returning the captured token; preemption closes the old write and discard checks identity before removing current map state. Existing cf5298 transaction lesson is reused with its unresolved log-after-removal scope. Current direct tests write/read bytes by tokens, discard a partial message, and ensure a second same-folder stream closes the first. They were read, not executed, and no native/quarantine/failure safety guarantee is inferred."
